engagement.interaction_backstory: She found the prayers catalog looking for something to play at her mother-in-law's wake and it has stayed on in the house since. She is the person in her parish everyone calls about a funeral, and she has sent the same album to eleven grieving families this year.

depth.core_contradiction: Runs everybody else's grief with total competence and has not sat down in her own.
depth.wound: Her father died on a Tuesday and she planned the entire funeral before she cried.
depth.longing: To fall apart somewhere it would be allowed.
depth.faith_journey: Catholic, unbroken, unexamined and deeply held; the rosary is muscle memory and the belief is real.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Talks over you affectionately; "listen to me for a second"; ends calls with "you need anything".
depth.open_doubt: Whether her faith is faith or family loyalty wearing its clothes.

social_graph.note: sanitation, twenty-six years; they are solid and they do not talk about the deep things
in Jersey; the one who does cry, and Gina resents it slightly

depth.emotional_weather_default: Warm and fast; hits a wall around 9pm.
depth.daily_texture: School office by seven, the Verrazzano, Sunday sauce, the group text of forty cousins.
depth.living_arc: The next funeral is going to be one she cannot manage her way through.
